info.name: Magewright
info.description: Magewright from Frontiers of Eberron: Quickstone

ul.li: Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Magic is part of everyday life in Eberron. Prestidigitation is an invaluable cantrip, whether you're a cook using it to heat and flavor food or a chimney sweep using it to wipe away dirt with a gesture. A blacksmith who doesn't know Mending is woefully unprepared. You could be an entertainer using Minor Image and Silent Image for your performances, or a courier relying on Longstrider. Consider the career you once followed, and choose a set of Artisan's Tools, cantrips, and a spell that could help with that work.

setters.set: Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Magic Initiate (Wizard) Feat, Arcana and Insight Skills, Artisan's Tools

description.p: This pack contains items that are given to a character of Magewright Background, if you chose option A for Equipment.
